data.text: Consult with the Lilly CRS/CRP for the appropriate length of time prior to the first dose of study treatment on additional therapies not mentioned.
For agents with known AEs occurring beyond the required wait period outlined in the table, this period must be extended until after the time during which the AE is known to occur.

A patient will be considered significantly noncompliant if he or she is judged by the investigator to have intentionally or repeatedly taken more or less than the prescribed amount of medication. The threshold required to maintain status as compliant will be at least 80% unless otherwise specified in Section 3.6.5 of the specifically enrolled addendum.

Investigators are not obligated to actively seek AEs or SAEs in patients once they have discontinued and/or completed the study (the patient summary CRF has been completed). However, if the investigator learns of any SAE, including a death, at any time after a patient has been discharged from the study, and he/she considers the event reasonably possibly related to the study treatment or study participation, the investigator must promptly notify Lilly.

Planned hospitalizations or procedures for preexisting conditions that were recorded in the patient's medical history at the time of enrollment should not be considered SAEs. Hospitalization or prolongation of hospitalization without a precipitating clinical AE (for example, for the administration of study treatment or other protocol_required procedure) should not be considered SAEs.
Serious adverse events, including death, caused by disease progression should not be reported unless the investigator deems them to be possibly related to study treatment.
Bioanalytical samples collected to measure study drug concentration will be retained for a maximum of 1 year following the last patient visit for the study.

A legal representative must give informed consent for a child to participate in this study. In addition to informed consent given by the legal representative, the child may be required to give documented assent, if capable.
The ERB/IRB should include or consult with experts who are knowledgeable in pediatric ethical, clinical, and psychosocial issues.
CCI

Participating in one investigation does not preclude the patient from enrolling in another investigation within the CAMPFIRE Master Protocol at a subsequent time as long as eligibility criteria are met.

data.name: Master Protocol Framework Objective
data.text: The main purpose of the CAMPFIRE Master Protocol is to create a framework to seamlessly evaluate the efficacy and safety of each investigational agent or study drug regimen eligible for development in specified populations of pediatric and young adult patients.

data.text: The clinical research objectives and endpoints for specific investigations are detailed in each individual addendum.

data.name: Informed consent and authorization
data.text: The patient, or patient's parent/guardian, has given written informed consent (and assent, as applicable) and authorization for release of health/information for research prior to any study_specific procedures being performed (refer to Appendix 2, Study Governance, Regulatory, and Ethical Considerations).

data.name: Performance score requirement
data.text: The patient has a Lansky (<16 years of age; Lansky et al. 1987) or Karnofsky (≥16 years of age; Karnofsky et al. 1948) performance score of at least 50.

data.name: Discontinuation of previous treatments
data.text: Patients must have discontinued all previous treatments for cancer or investigational agents ≥7 days after the last dose or as shown below, and must have recovered from the acute effects to ≤Grade 2 for alopecia and decreased tendon reflex and to ≤Grade 1 for all other effects at the time of enrollment, unless otherwise noted. For agents with known AEs occurring beyond the required wait period outlined in the table, this period must be extended until after the time during which the AE is known to occur. Consult with the Lilly CRS/CRP for the appropriate length of time prior to the first dose of study treatment on additional therapies not mentioned. Previous treatments and required wait periods: Cytotoxic and myelosuppressive chemotherapy: ≥14 days after the last dose of cytotoxic or myelosuppressive chemotherapy (or ≥42 days if prior nitrosourea); Hematopoietic growth factors: ≥14 days after the last dose of a long_acting growth factor (for example, pegfilgrastim) or ≥48 hours for short_acting growth factor; Cellular therapy: ≥42 days after the completion of any type of cellular therapy (eg modified T cells, NK cells, dendritic cells, etc.) agent; Interleukins, interferons, and cytokines (other than hematopoietic growth factors): ≥21 days after the completion of interleukins, interferon, or cytokines (other than hematopoietic growth factors); Antibody therapy: ≥21 days after the last infusion of antibody therapy; Radiotherapy: ≥14 days since local palliative radiation therapy (RT) (small port); craniospinal XRT, or 50% or greater pelvic radiation; ≥42 days for other substantial radiation (such as metaiodobenzylguanidine therapy); Radiopharmaceutical therapy (eg, radiolabeled antibody, 131I_MIBG): ≥42 days after systemically administered radiopharmaceutical therapy; Stem cell infusion without TBI: ≥84 days must have elapsed after auto_transplant or stem cell infusion; Corticosteroids: ≥14 days for patients who have received a course of systemic corticosteroids (≥5 days) to modify immune AEs related to prior therapy. Note: Patients who are on chronic replacement dose for endocrine disorders or are on a stable or decreasing dose for indications other than treating the underlying cancer, may still be eligible (consult Lilly CRP/CRS); Live vaccines: ≥28 days after last live vaccine.

data.name: Full Study Discontinuation
data.text: The study will be discontinued if Lilly judges it necessary for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Early Termination _ Disease Progression
data.description: Patient discontinued from study treatment due to radiographic progressive disease or significant symptomatic disease deterioration

data.name: Early Termination _ Unacceptable Toxicity
data.description: Patient discontinued from study treatment due to unacceptable toxicity, such as persistent moderate toxicity intolerable to the patient

data.name: Early Termination _ Pregnancy
data.description: Patient discontinued from study treatment and/or addendum due to pregnancy; fetal outcome reporting required per SAE process

data.name: Early Termination _ Noncompliance
data.description: Patient discontinued due to noncompliance with study procedures and/or treatment; threshold is less than 80% compliance unless otherwise specified

data.name: Early Termination _ Incompatible Study Enrollment
data.description: Patient enrolled in another clinical study involving an investigational product or medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study

data.name: Early Termination _ Rescue Therapy Required
data.description: Patient requires treatment with another therapeutic agent demonstrated to be effective for the study indication; discontinuation from study drug occurs prior to introduction of the other agent

data.name: Early Termination _ Maximum Dose Reductions Reached
data.description: Patient has had maximum dose reductions allowed per protocol and experiences an AE requiring additional dose reduction

data.name: Early Termination _ Investigator Decision
data.description: Investigator/physician decides patient should be discontinued from study or study drug

data.name: Early Termination _ Patient/Guardian Decision
data.description: Patient or patient's designee (parents or legal guardian) requests discontinuation from study or study drug

data.name: Early Termination _ Sponsor Decision
data.description: Lilly stops the study or stops the patient's participation for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Early Termination _ Lost to Follow_Up
data.description: Patient repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site despite diligent attempts

data.name: Study Completion _ Investigation Final Analysis
data.description: Completion of investigation occurs following the final analysis as defined in the applicable addenda and when determined by Lilly; investigators continue to follow investigation_specific Schedule of Activities until notified by Lilly

data.name: Continued Access Period End
data.description: Patient's continued access to study treatment ends when a criterion for discontinuation is met per Section 8; continued access follow_up lasts approximately 30 (±7) days

data.name: Protocol Deviation _ Inadvertent Enrollment
data.description: Patient who did not meet enrollment criteria was inadvertently enrolled; Lilly CRP/CRS and investigator must discuss to determine if patient may continue; if not medically appropriate to continue, patient is discontinued

data.name: Study Site Closure
data.description: Study site participation discontinued if Lilly, investigator, or ERB/IRB judges it necessary for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons

data.name: Full Study Discontinuation by Sponsor
data.description: The study will be discontinued if Lilly judges it necessary for medical, safety, regulatory, or other reasons consistent with applicable laws, regulations, and GCP

data.name: Screen Failure Re_screening Decision
data.description: Decision point for whether a screen failure may be re_screened; requires discussion with and permission from Lilly CRP/CRS or designee; laboratory tests may not be repeated more than twice

data.name: Inadvertent Enrollment Continuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for whether an inadvertently enrolled patient may continue in the study; requires agreement between Lilly CRP/CRS and investigator that it is medically appropriate, with documented approval

data.name: Continued Access Eligibility Decision
data.description: After final analysis and Lilly declaration of continued access period, decision point for whether patients still on study treatment may continue based on clinical benefit and absence of undue risks

data.name: Noncompliance Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for potential discontinuation due to study drug noncompliance; must be discussed between investigator and Lilly CRP/CRS before final determination; threshold is at least 80% compliance

data.name: Disease Progression Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point for discontinuation due to radiographic progressive disease or significant symptomatic deterioration; every effort should be made to document disease progression unless not medically appropriate

data.name: Dose Modification vs. Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Decision point when patient experiences AE requiring dose modification; if maximum dose reductions already reached, discontinuation is triggered; otherwise dose modification per addendum_specific rules applies

data.name: Long_Term Follow_Up Discontinuation at Continued Access Start
data.description: Decision point at start of continued access period: patients in long_term follow_up are discontinued from long_term follow_up; patients in short_term follow_up continue until 30_day visit is completed

data.name: Adaptive Randomization Decision
data.description: For addenda incorporating adaptive treatment randomization methodology, adaptation rules as described in the applicable addendum govern treatment allocation decisions

data.name: Lilly investigational drug(s)
data.description: Eli Lilly and Company investigational drugs evaluated alone or in combination with various treatments in pediatric and young adult patients with cancer. Specific agents are defined in individual protocol addenda.

data.name: Combination agents / comparator treatments
data.description: Various available treatments or other investigational agents used in combination with or as comparators to Lilly investigational drugs. Specific comparators are defined in individual protocol addenda. Common control arms may be shared across addenda.

data.name: Concomitant supportive care medications
data.description: Permitted supportive care therapies including sedatives, antibiotics, analgesics, antihistamines, corticosteroids (chronic replacement dose or stable/decreasing dose for non_cancer indications), erythropoietin, blood products (blood cells, platelets, fresh frozen plasma transfusions), and procedures such as paracentesis and thoracentesis. All must be documented on eCRF.

data.name: Hematopoietic growth factors
data.description: G_CSF and other hematopoietic growth factors permitted up to 48 hours (short_acting) or 14 days (long_acting, e.g., pegfilgrastim) prior to first dose of study treatment. Also permitted during study as supportive care.

data.name: Platelet transfusions
data.description: Platelet transfusions permitted up to 72 hours prior to first dose to meet eligibility criteria (platelets ≥75,000/mm3).

data.name: Red blood cell transfusions
data.description: Transfusions permitted to increase hemoglobin to at least 8 g/dL for eligibility; study treatment must not begin until 7 days after transfusion and CBC criteria confirmed within 24 hours of C1D1.

data.name: Chemotherapy (cytotoxic and myelosuppressive)
data.description: Must be discontinued ≥14 days before first dose of study treatment (≥42 days if prior nitrosourea). Patient must have recovered from acute effects.

data.name: Cellular therapy
data.description: Modified T cells, NK cells, dendritic cells, etc. must be discontinued ≥42 days before first dose of study treatment.

data.name: Interleukins, interferons, and cytokines
data.description: Must be discontinued ≥21 days before first dose of study treatment (excluding hematopoietic growth factors).

data.name: Antibody therapy
data.description: Must be discontinued ≥21 days (last infusion) before first dose of study treatment.

data.name: Radiotherapy
data.description: Local palliative RT (small port): ≥14 days; craniospinal XRT or ≥50% pelvic radiation: ≥14 days; other substantial radiation (e.g., metaiodobenzylguanidine therapy): ≥42 days before first dose of study treatment.

data.name: Radiopharmaceutical therapy
data.description: Systemically administered radiopharmaceutical therapy (e.g., radiolabeled antibody, 131I_MIBG) must be discontinued ≥42 days before first dose of study treatment.

data.name: Stem cell infusion (without TBI)
data.description: Auto_transplant or stem cell infusion must have occurred ≥84 days before first dose of study treatment.

data.name: Systemic corticosteroids
data.description: Patients who received a course of systemic corticosteroids (≥5 days) to modify immune AEs related to prior therapy must have discontinued ≥14 days before first dose. Patients on chronic replacement dose for endocrine disorders or stable/decreasing dose for non_cancer indications may still be eligible.

data.name: Live vaccines
data.description: Must be discontinued ≥28 days before first dose of study treatment.

data.name: Other chemotherapy, investigational medications, anticancer therapy, immunotherapy, hormonal cancer therapy
data.description: Prohibited while patients are on study treatment. No other chemotherapy, investigational medications, other anticancer therapy, immunotherapy, hormonal cancer therapy, palliative radiation, or palliative surgery for cancer permitted during study treatment. Exceptions defined in each addendum.

data.rationale: Section 2 references a Schedule of Activities implying repeated data collection at scheduled study visits
Section 6.1 inclusion criteria are evaluated once at screening to determine eligibility
Section 6.2 exclusion criteria are evaluated once at screening to determine eligibility
Section 6.4 screen failures are recorded as a one_time assessment at the screening visit
Section 7.6 treatment compliance is assessed repeatedly at each study visit throughout the trial
Section 7.7 concomitant therapy is reviewed and updated at each scheduled study visit
Section 7.4 dose modification involves conditional decision points based on patient response or adverse events
Section 8 discontinuation criteria represent a conditional workflow triggered by specific clinical events or decision points
Section 3.3 benefit/risk assessment is conducted once as part of the protocol design and study rationale
Section 7.8.1.1 continued access involves conditional decision_making based on study completion and eligibility criteria
